ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; do not pay out the $4.50 driver portion; remind driver that 'I'm Here' may only be pressed after arrival at the pick-up point (RD/NS compliance).

rejected_claims.reason: Contradicted by the GPS trace: driver was still travelling at 22.7–27.5 km/h at 21:28:00, reached the pick-up area around 21:28:05–21:29:00 and cancelled at 21:30:55 — at most ~1 min 45 s of stationary waiting after his 'I'm Here' press, below the 3-minute requirement (NS-1(iii)).
The $6.61 cancellation fee requires all of NS-1(i)-(iii); with the >3-minute wait within 200 m of the pick-up point not established, the fee does not stand and is refunded in full (NS-2).
